theme: An open day with decisions stacking up behind it.
greeting: A rare empty Saturday, Dan — nothing on the calendar, the girls around for one more day before tomorrow's handoff. The real work is making the travel calls now, before tomorrow's 9 AM review forces every one of them.

needsAttention.title: Come to the Sunday review ready to decide
needsAttention.detail: You and Mike run the 15-minute board review at 9 AM tomorrow. The agenda is the three travel calls below — arrive having picked, not to relitigate them at the counter.

needsAttention.title: December trip — pick a lane this weekend
needsAttention.detail: The destination decision was due Sept 30 and six seats over three holiday weeks book by Oct 15. Domestic has nothing to wait on; international only works on refundable holds since the passports land mid-November.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV now
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market and it sells out. The task says book refundable today and fix the dates later — it's been open since Sept 14.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Pathfinder drive-south plan
needsAttention.detail: The Portland → St Pete window is Oct 5–18 — the off-week that starts this weekend. Driving it replaces a flight and kills the monthly rentals; the open piece is where the car sits the weeks you're not in Florida.

flagged.title: Drew's notes on your ICGN bio
flagged.detail: He sent edits for your Toronto panel bio and thinks the LinkedIn announcement could sparkle more — still awaiting your next move.

flagged.title: AppleCare One wants a sign-in
flagged.detail: Apple flags a new account signed in to your iPhone 17e and says you must sign in to keep coverage — worth verifying it's you.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley statement posted
flagged.detail: A new account statement is available on Morgan Stanley Online. No action, just a glance.

flagged.title: Lauren Misrahi is waiting on your RSVP
flagged.detail: An Evite invitation is still open and asking whether you can make it.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, retail, travel deals and LinkedIn comment pings — nothing that needs you.

resolved.title: FICO Advanced subscription canceled
resolved.detail: myFICO confirmed the cancellation Oct 2 — no further charges to watch for.

recipe.title: Roast chicken smothered with chanterelles
recipe.why: Chanterelle season and roasting weather make this a natural for an autumn evening.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + shower soap holder (needs delivery address)

acts.line: A clear Saturday in St. Pete with nothing on the calendar to answer to.
The open stretch to make the three travel calls before tomorrow's review puts them on the table.
One last night with the girls before tomorrow's ~6 PM handoff to Jen opens the off-week.
